changeSet.author: Puneet Gupta
changeSet.sql:
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Resource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Status') begin if exists (select sdc.name from sys.default_constraints sdc where object_name(sdc.parent_object_id) = 'Resource' and sdc.name = 'DF_Resource_Status' ) begin alter table [dbo].[Resource] drop constraint DF_Resource_Status; end
alter table [dbo].[Resource] drop column [Status] end
changeSet.rollback:
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' and TABLE_NAME = 'Resource' and COLUMN_NAME = 'Status') begin alter table [dbo].[Resource] add [Status] [varchar](25)
alter table [dbo].[Resource] add constraint [DF_Resource_Status] default ('Active') FOR [Status] end
